scripts.render:hero: remotion render GingaHero-pt out/ginga-hero-pt.mp4 --crf=20 && remotion render GingaHero-en out/ginga-hero-en.mp4 --crf=20
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render GingaVertical-pt out/ginga-vertical-pt.mp4 --crf=20 && remotion render GingaVertical-en out/ginga-vertical-en.mp4 --crf=20
scripts.render:loop: remotion render GingaLoop-pt out/ginga-loop.webm --codec=vp9 --crf=40 && remotion render GingaLoop-pt out/ginga-loop.mp4 --crf=28
scripts.render:teaser: remotion render GingaTeaser-pt out/ginga-teaser-pt.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 && remotion render GingaTeaser-en out/ginga-teaser-en.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:keynote: remotion render GingaKeynote-pt out/ginga-keynote-pt-master.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --timeout=180000 && remotion ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/ginga-keynote-pt-master.mov -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart out/ginga-keynote-pt.mp4 && remotion render GingaKeynote-en out/ginga-keynote-en-master.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --timeout=180000 && remotion ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/ginga-keynote-en-master.mov -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart out/ginga-keynote-en.mp4
